HERO.BADGE: Purpose-built for tutoring academies & training institutes
HERO.SUBTITLE: Netrofit is a financial-and-operations platform purpose-built for tutoring academies, training institutes, and language schools in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf. Real-time P&L, multi-branch dashboards, installment tracking, and payroll — in one place.

BENEFITS.HEADING: Built for how academies actually run.
BENEFITS.SUB: Generic ERPs were never made for tutoring centers. We fix the specific things that drive you crazy.

ITEMS.REALTIME_TEXT: No waiting for the accountant. See revenue, expenses, and profit for every branch — live.
ITEMS.MULTIBRANCH_TEXT: Manage 2 or 20 branches from one dashboard. Compare performance side by side.
ITEMS.INSTALLMENTS_TEXT: Track who owes what, when. Get reminders for overdue installments automatically.
ITEMS.ARABIC_TEXT: Full RTL support. Your staff can use it from day one — no English barrier.
ITEMS.PAYROLL_TEXT: Track instructor sessions, salaries, and bonuses. Print payslips in one click.
ITEMS.ROLES_TEXT: Give every team member exactly the access they need — branch managers, instructors, accountants — with granular per-feature controls.

ITEMS.MULTIBRANCH_TEXT: Run as many branches as you need. Each tenant's data is isolated — full P&L per branch and consolidated at the company.
ITEMS.DASHBOARD_TEXT: Real-time revenue, expenses, gross / net profit, available cash, and branch-by-branch performance.
ITEMS.STUDENTS_TEXT: Profiles, contact info, parent details, enrollment history, refund history — searchable and filterable.
ITEMS.COURSES_TEXT: Define courses with pricing, duration, and prerequisites. Reuse across branches.
ITEMS.BUNDLES_TEXT: Sell "all-access" bundles — students enroll in any included course at no extra charge.
ITEMS.CLASSES_TEXT: Schedule classes, assign instructors, cap enrollments, mark classes finished, track current enrollment.
ITEMS.SESSIONS_TEXT: Start and end real-time class sessions, track which sessions are active, and review session history.
ITEMS.TIMETABLE_TEXT: Day-by-day visual timetable showing classes, rooms, and instructors so the front desk never double-books.
ITEMS.ROOMS_TEXT: Manage classrooms and shared spaces, assign them to sessions, and prevent collisions.
ITEMS.ATTENDANCE_TEXT: Mark per-session attendance for each student, look up by student or class, and use for payroll.
ITEMS.EMPLOYEES_TEXT: Employee directory with role, branch, salary, and status. Convert employees to system users in one click.
ITEMS.PAYROLL_TEXT: Pay individual salaries or run a one-click monthly payroll for the whole branch with bonus / discount support.
ITEMS.ENROLLMENTS_TEXT: Single or bundle enrollments with discount handling, payment mode, and full payment history.
ITEMS.INSTALLMENTS_TEXT: Track who owes what and when, see all overdue dues in one place, and record partial payments instantly.
ITEMS.REVENUES_TEXT: Every payment from enrollments, bundles, and product sales rolls into a unified revenue ledger.
ITEMS.EXPENSES_TEXT: Categorize as fixed / variable / shared / capital, tag with category (rent, utilities, marketing, COGS…), branch-scoped or company-wide.
ITEMS.RECURRING_TEXT: Define recurring monthly expenses once. Pay them in a click; the dashboard surfaces what's due.
ITEMS.REFUNDS_TEXT: Issue full or partial refunds against any enrollment or bundle, with full audit trail.
ITEMS.WITHDRAWALS_TEXT: Track owner draws, profit distributions, and dividends separately from operating expenses.
ITEMS.DEBTS_TEXT: Record loans and outstanding obligations and watch them shrink as payments come in.
ITEMS.CASH_TEXT: Live cash position computed from real movements, with manual adjustments, deposits, and per-branch breakdown.
ITEMS.INVENTORY_TEXT: Stock per branch, low-stock alerts, restocking, and stock adjustments tied to product cost.
ITEMS.SALES_TEXT: Front-desk product sales with discounts, receipt numbers, customer info, and auto-deducted COGS.
ITEMS.EVENTS_TEXT: Run pop-up sales events, track event-specific revenue and P&L, link product sales back to the event.
ITEMS.ANALYTICS_TEXT: Profit by branch, by course, by product. Salary growth, monthly P&L, top performers — every chart you need.
ITEMS.REPORTS_TEXT: Student churn, revenue trends, expense categories, and downloadable monthly P&L reports.
ITEMS.RBAC_TEXT: 8 roles plus per-user overrides. Granular read / write / delete on every resource — give each teammate exactly what they need.
ITEMS.BILINGUAL_TEXT: Full RTL Arabic UI built-in. Switch languages per user. Onboard local staff with zero language barrier.

FAQ.HEADING: Questions, answered.
FAQ.A1: You can be live within 48 hours. We import your student list and branch data for you during onboarding.
FAQ.A2: Netrofit is cloud-based so you need internet to use it. It runs great on mobile data and saves your work if the connection drops briefly.
FAQ.Q3: Can I try before I buy?
FAQ.A3: Yes — every plan comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
FAQ.A4: Your data lives on AWS with encryption at rest and in transit, automatic daily backups, and multi-tenant isolation so no other customer can ever see your numbers.
FAQ.Q5: Can you customize for my business?
FAQ.A5: Absolutely. Our Pro plan includes custom workflows, and we offer white-label for franchise networks.
FAQ.Q6: What payment methods do you support?
FAQ.A6: Bank transfer, Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, Fawry, credit card, and cash (tracked manually with receipts).
